answers.core: Yes. OKLCH is increasingly adopted in industry standards like CSS and Tailwind. Since Godot already provides OKHSL at the core level, having OKLCH alongside it would be a natural extension. It ensures developers can work with modern perceptual color spaces without relying on external add-ons, improving both accessibility and long-term maintainability.
answers.workaround: No, converting it requires more code than expected and causes inconvenience in implementation.
